description: Amendments to planning permission dated 23 June 2015 (Ref: 15/00132/FULL) for, 'Excavation beneath footprint of building, rear garden and garage; erection of single storey rear extension at lower ground floor level with external terrace above; alterations and extensions at roof level including creation of roof terrace; excavation beneath pavement vaults; and associated alterations (including plant to rear); all to enlarge dwellinghouse (Class C3)';  Namely, the omission of the entire consented basement and indoor pool, the reconfiguration of the master bedroom layout to provide a singular lift access rather than double lift arrangement, the relocation and expansion of the rear lightwell, the optimisation of the top floor to extend the ridge of the existing rear mansard roof horizontally before it slopes down to meet the existing front mansard roof ridge, and increase the extent of elevational glazing, relocating the garage to the ground floor of 3 Red Lion Yard, introduction of comfort cooling and repair and replacement work as necessary to the existing facades.
